subject: Acceptance lanes & monthly throttle commit plan discussion
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@edgescale.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: proposed acceptance lanes & monthly throttle (TPM) plan

Hi Lisa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft and an initial pricing/ramp proposal that ties discounts to monthly TPM (tokens per minute-equivalent) thresholds. High level:

- Pilot (Month 1–2): 100M tokens/month target (evaluation), limited SLA, 10% discount on list for pilot usage.
- Ramp (Month 3–6): staged monthly TPM targets: 200M -> 400M -> 700M -> 1.0B tokens. Discounts increase at each slab (15% / 20% / 25% / 30%), with an overage rate schedule if targets are missed.
- Acceptance lanes: "functional" (end-to-end feature validation) and "scale" (throughput/latency). Acceptance signoffs are separate — functional signoff unlocks feature payment; scale signoff moves into committed pricing.

Two asks from you to finalize:
1) Confirm the evaluation window you want for Month 1–2 (we proposed 60 days).
2) Confirm preferred TPM targets in the Ramp (we can smooth the steps if they prefer monthly ramp-by-25% instead).

I attached MAP_EdgeScale_v3.pdf (draft), pricing_slides_edge_v2.xlsx (detailed slab math), and a 1-page summary.

If that looks good I'll route the recommended concession (one-time onboarding credit) to Marissa for approval and share a DocuSign-ready MAP + SOW.

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

Attachment: MAP_EdgeScale_v3.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: pricing_slides_edge_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Lisa Chen <lisa@edgescale.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@edgescale.com
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: proposed acceptance lanes & monthly throttle (TPM) plan

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few quick notes from our side:

- Evaluation window: procurement wants 45 days rather than 60. Can we compress without losing signal?
- TPM targets: the proposed jump to 700M in month 5 looks aggressive for us. Can you provide a smoothing option (e.g., +25% month over month) and show the economics?
- Discounts: procurement is asking if the top-tier 30% discount is contingent on sustained usage (e.g., 3 consecutive months at target) or immediate once the TPM is reached. Please clarify.

Also looping in procurement (procurement@edgescale.com) to handle legal and billing cadence.

If you can get the smoothing option and the discount rule into the MAP we can accelerate internal approval.

Cheers,
Lisa Chen
VP Product, EdgeScale Inc.
lisa@edgescale.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa@edgescale.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com, procurement@edgescale.com
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: proposed acceptance lanes & monthly throttle (TPM) plan

Lisa — thanks, noted. Quick answers and an alternate ramp attached: pricing_slides_edge_v2.xlsx includes the smoothing view. Summary here:

- Evaluation window: we can compress to 45 days, but to preserve signal we recommend keeping the functional acceptance items tightly scoped (3 critical user flows). We'll list those in the MAP amendment.
- Smoothing option: proposed alternative is +25% MoM from baseline 100M -> 125M -> 156M -> 195M -> 244M -> 305M (month 6). I included a second sheet that maps that smoothing to equivalent discounts; we keep the same slab breakpoints but prorate the discount ramp based on cumulative TPM achieved.
- Discount condition: top-tier discount (30%) is contingent on sustaining >= target slab for 2 consecutive months OR meeting cumulative quarter target. We can make the condition either-or depending on procurement preference (we put both options in the MAP).

FWIW, Marissa has authority for a one-time onboarding credit up to $25k; anything above that needs Jonas sign-off.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll update MAP_EdgeScale_v3.pdf to include the smoothing table and the discount condition language.
2) Marissa — can you confirm onboarding credit approval cap?
3) Jonas — can you confirm whether the contract team will accept the 2-month sustain OR cumulative quarter language for the top-tier discount?

If procurement prefers, we can exchange a redlined MAP in Google Drive and then push to DocuSign once legal is OK.

Thanks,
Rishi

Attachment: pricing_slides_edge_v2.xlsx (XLSX)

Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff: proposed acceptance lanes & monthly throttle (TPM) plan

Marissa / Jonas — forwarding EdgeScale thread. Key asks: compress evaluation to 45 days, provide smoothing ramp option (+25% MoM), and clarify top-tier discount condition (2 months sustain OR cumulative quarter).

Notes for you:
- Recommended onboarding credit: $20k (falls under Marissa's authority).
- If we accept the 2-month sustain clause, contract will need language for measurement (rolling 30-day window tracked via our Console metrics). If they prefer cumulative quarter, billing will invoice based on quarter attainment and calculate retroactive credit.

Jonas: do you foresee any objections to either measurement approach from legal/billing? Prefer to avoid an escrow or deferred credit if possible — simpler is better for finance.

Thanks — Rishi

Lisa / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is MAP_EdgeScale_v3_updated.pdf with the smoothing schedule and two options for the top-tier discount measurement (2-month sustain OR cumulative quarter). Highlights:

- Evaluation compressed to 45 days; functional acceptance list included (3 must-pass flows).
- Smoothing plan included (+25% MoM) with a projection sheet showing expected token spend and cost/promo per month.
- Discount rule: draft language provides both measurement options; procurement can pick which to include in the SOW.
